Daisy ran to her mommy and said, "Mommy, I saw a big, dark cloud! What will happen if it rains?" Mommy smiled and said, "Don't worry, Daisy. It will pass soon."
Daisy did not want to wait. She played in the rain and got all wet. Then, it started to rain. Daisy was so happy that she danced in the rain. She jumped and laughed.
